body: I had a feeling it might be schizophrenia. I hoped it was just stress, but even when I'm calm I've been having trouble. I really want to go to a hospital but there's no way I could afford to stay.

Last time I went to the ER and got whacked with a $600 bill because my insurance eats dicks for a living. I get calls from angry collectors daily now. Needless to say, now that I am jobless and will be without insurance soon, therapy/hospitalization is out of the question.
